name: shadow_tier1_screening
description: Initial geospatial proximity analysis to determine if detailed shadow study is warranted. Performs buffer analysis around building footprint based on height to identify potentially affected sensitive sites.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

sensitive_sites.description: Layer of sensitive sites (parks, playgrounds, etc.). If not provided, default NYC dataset will be used.

buffer_multiplier.description: Multiplier for shadow radius (default: 4.0, meaning 4x building height)

triggered.description: Whether detailed analysis is triggered (true if any sensitive sites are within shadow radius)

affected_sites.description: GeoJSON of sites within shadow radius

affected_sites_count.description: Number of sensitive sites within shadow radius

shadow_buffer.description: Buffer zone representing potential shadow area

summary_report.description: Summary of screening results in text format

visualization.description: Interactive map showing buffer and intersected sites
